messages:
Maya: heads up — Voltware reported a bunch of duplicate credits after a fleet firmware rollout on older devices. customers hit refunds. need a short-term mitigation + backfill plan :warning:
Sam: tl;dr? can you paste one of the payloads?
Maya: here's a typical webhook they sent:
```json
{
  "device_serial": "VW-000123",
  "sku": "cloud-edge-1",
  "usage_total": 124000,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T23:09:00Z",
  "firmware": "v1.2.0"
}
```
Jorge: they send cumulative counters, not deltas. after the fw update many devices reset counters to 0 or re-provisioned serials changed. our normal cumulative->delta conversion produced large positive deltas (or negative which we sometimes coerce), leading to double credits when device reappeared with higher offset.
Priya: which customers/time window? any credits already posted?
Maya: window ~= Mar 20-22. two enterprise customers flagged obvious double-counting in invoices. looks like some credits already posted.
Alex: short-term mitigation: on ingestion run cumulative->delta using per-device last_seen_total. if computed delta < 0 (reset), do NOT emit billing credits — instead mark event with `reset_hint` and route to a holding queue. medium-term: require event_uuid + monotonic counter from partner. long-term: add `firmware_update` flag in telemetry and explicit last_total snapshot field.
Sam: I can implement a hotfix in usage-normalizer to annotate and drop negative deltas (emit audit event). how fast do we want this?
Jorge: partner-side: we can push a firmware toggle that sets `firmware_update=true` on batch webhooks for devices updated. they can also include `last_total` per device but that'll take more work. we can get the toggle today, full event_uuid/monotonic counter in ~6 weeks (firmware cadence).
Priya: for billing/backfill we'll need either (A) partner-provided pre-reset snapshots per device, or (B) a conservative reconciliation using historical per-SKU consumption to cap deltas. customers want remediation policy. what's our tolerance for provisional credits?
Maya: proposed plan + owners:
  - Emergency ingestion filter: Sam — hotfix to mark/drop negative deltas and route to manual queue (ETA 2h)
  - Partner contract/telemetry toggle: Jorge — ask Voltware to enable `firmware_update` flag and include `last_total` where possible (ETA 1 business day for flag)
  - Backfill + customer comms: Priya — run reconciliation, propose provisional credits, and prepare comms (ETA 2 business days)
Can owners ack?
Sam: ack. I'll open PR, run staging tests, and prepare hotfix deploy. :thumbsup:
Jorge: ack. pinging Voltware now and will report back in this thread.
Priya: ack. drafting a short customer note and provisional credit policy (will share).
BillingBot: Created ticket #BILL-4321 for backfill run and audit log collection.
Maya: thanks all. I'll own the follow-up postmortem and contract language tweak. cc @legal for the contract addition re: event_uuid requirement. keeping this thread as the single source of truth. :eyes:
